headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY
summary: As of September 17, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 25.13% compared to SPY's 12.54%. This results in an average alpha of 12.59%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 50.27%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 7.25%, demonstrating a clear disparity in performance among the portfolios. This outperformance is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience relative to broader market movements. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
